production_equivalence.scope: Same production and single-image build inputs as the feature-policy component/native checkpoint; these are separately linked binaries.

limits: Includes corrected bell notification ownership and actual host activation. Remote Consolas grids; not local 160x48 Sarasa acceptance. The GDI total target is approximately 50 MB. Current DX memory is accepted by the user; no further DX optimization is required. The ordinary workflow has a separate checkpoint and archive. This image includes UDK with 232 native streams, Locator, CAN/SUB parity and all 413 earlier native reference streams.
